name: offline-site-packer
description: Turn a built static website into an offline copy that opens by double-clicking index.html: crawls every internal page from the home page, rewrites root-relative, pretty and extension-less links (and CSS url()/@import, srcset) to relative file paths, copies only the files used, adds an offline full-text search box (MiniSearch, ⌘K) to every page, and reports broken links, missing files, external links and pages nothing links to. Writes a folder and a zip. No server, no network.

description_i18n.en: Turn a built static website into an offline copy that opens by double-clicking index.html: crawls every internal page from the home page, rewrites root-relative, pretty and extension-less links (and CSS url()/@import, srcset) to relative file paths, copies only the files used, adds an offline full-text search box (MiniSearch, ⌘K) to every page, and reports broken links, missing files, external links and pages nothing links to. Writes a folder and a zip. No server, no network.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把构建好的静态网站做成离线版，双击 index.html 就能浏览：从首页出发爬取所有站内页面，把根路径、目录式和省略扩展名的链接（以及 CSS 的 url()/@import、srcset）改成相对文件路径，只复制用到的文件，给每个页面加上离线全文搜索（MiniSearch，⌘K），并报告坏链、缺失文件、外部链接和没被链接的页面。输出文件夹和 zip。不需要服务器，不联网。
